# Script tools

8 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `read_script`

Read the full source code of a GDScript file

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the script, e.g. 'res://scripts/Player.gd' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-02:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd"
}
```

## `create_script`

Create a new GDScript file with optional extends and class_name

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | Save path, e.g. 'res://scripts/Enemy.gd' |
| `extends_type` | `string` | — | Base class to extend, e.g. 'Node2D', 'CharacterBody2D' |
| `class_name_str` | `string` | — | Optional class_name declaration |
| `content` | `string` | — | Full script body to write. If omitted, a minimal template is generated. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-01:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd",
  "content": "extends Node\n\nvar value: int = 0\n\nfunc increment() -> void:\n\tvalue += 1\n\nfunc get_value() -> int:\n\treturn value\n"
}
```

## `edit_script`

Edit a GDScript file: replace all content or a specific line range

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the script to edit |
| `content` | `string` | yes | New content to write |
| `start_line` | `number` | — | First line to replace (1-based). Omit to replace entire file. |
| `end_line` | `number` | — | Last line to replace (1-based, inclusive). Omit to replace entire file. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-06:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd",
  "content": "extends Node\n\nvar value: int = 0\n\nfunc increment(step: int = 1) -> void:\n\tvalue += step\n\nfunc get_value() -> int:\n\treturn value\n\nfunc reset() -> void:\n\tvalue = 0\n"
}
```

## `attach_script`

Attach a GDScript to a node in the active scene (supports UndoRedo). Creates the file if it does not exist.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node to attach the script to |
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | Path to an existing or new script file |
| `extends_type` | `string` | — | Base class for the new script if it needs to be created |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-08:

```json
{
  "node_path": ".",
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd"
}
```

## `validate_syntax`

Validate GDScript syntax without saving. Pass source code or a file path.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `source_code` | `string` | — | GDScript source code to validate |
| `script_path` | `string` | — | Path to a script file to validate (alternative to source_code) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-03:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd"
}
```

## `search_in_scripts`

Search for a text pattern in all .gd files, returns matches with file path and line number

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `query` | `string` | yes | Text to search for |
| `path` | `string` | — | Root folder to search under (default: res://) |
| `case_sensitive` | `boolean` | — | Whether the search is case-sensitive (default: false) |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum matching lines to return (default 500, negative for no limit). The response carries truncated: true when the search stopped early. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-09:

```json
{
  "query": "increment"
}
```

## `get_script_info`

Get metadata about a GDScript: class name, base class, methods, signals, properties

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the script file |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-07:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://test_tool.gd"
}
```

## `reload_scripts`

Reload all GDScripts in the editor (equivalent to editor Reload Scripts action)

Takes no parameters.

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/04-script.json`, test SC-10:

```json
{}
```
